intro: Инфляция describes a general price increase over a period; it does not mean that each product goes up the same and that all households spend the same.

bloques.titulo: Инфляция describes a general price increase over a period; it does not mean that each product goes up the same and that all households spend the same.
texto: Инфляция describes a general price increase over a period; it does not mean that each product goes up the same and that all households spend the same.
Compare same period, index and product basket before interpreting a percentage variation.

frases.ru: За год средняя стоимость продуктовой корзины выросла на семь процентов.
frases.es: En un año, el coste medio de la cesta de la compra subió un siete por ciento.
frases.en: In a year, the average cost of the shopping basket increased by seven percent.

frases.ru: При этом цены на овощи увеличились сильнее, чем цены на крупы.
frases.es: Aun así, los precios de las verduras subieron más que los de los cereales.
frases.en: However, the prices of vegetables went up more than those of cereals.

bloques.pregunta: What price group increased the most?

opciones.explicacion: The second sentence compares both groups and states that the vegetables went up more.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
